issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #90

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Blockbuster holds a meeting of his inner circle, including Mayor Zucco. He informs them that he has hired the legendary crime boss La Agente Funebre to kill Dick Grayson, and her operative has decided to ensure the job gets done by launching a drone strike on Dick's apartment building. Melinda texts Dick a warning, just in time for him to trigger the fire alarm and evacuate the building, but he has to go back in to rescue a deaf tenant who slept through the alarm. As Nightwing he grabs the man and jumps out of the window just as a stinger missile hits the building.

In Keystone City, Wally West hears the news and runs to Bludhaven. Bystanders tell him Dick Grayson didn't get out before the explosion and he frantically digs in the rubble looking for Dick until he sees Nightwing nearby. Flash tells Dick that he is currently missing and presumed dead, and advises that he take the opportunity to lie low until they can deal with the assassins, transporting Dick to his house before he can react. Exhausted, Dick agrees to stay the night.

The next morning, Commissioner Maclean questions the survivors and realises that Dick had advanced warning of the attack, and tells Blockbuster that there is a mole inside their organisation. Meanwhile in Gotham, two armed men kidnap Barbara Gordon and throw her in a truck, hoping to use her as bait to draw Dick out. She calls Dick and Wally, who catch up to the truck and secretly swap places with her. The truck meets with La Agente Funebre's hired killer, revealed to be KGBeast. When the kidnappers open the doors, Flash and Nightwing leap out and attack.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #91

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing and the Flash easily defeat KGBeast and his men. They steal Knyazev's phone and Oracle is able to use it to trace La Agente Funebre to a compound in Costa Rica. The two heroes not only manage to defeat the legendary master assassin, but Dick also uses her network to send multiple notorious assassins into traps where they are apprehended by superheroes.

In Bludhaven, Lady Shiva meets with Blockbuster and informs him that no assassin will accept a contract on Dick Grayson, as it has proven too risky. She tells him that if he wants Dick dead, he will have to kill him himself.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #92

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Dick's community centre "Haven" finally opens in spite of Blockbuster's attempts to prevent it. Blockbuster attends the ribbon-cutting ceremony accompanied by Commissioner Maclean and Mayor Zucco. Blockbuster obliquely threatens Dick but backs down when the event's special guest Superman arrives. Melinda tells Dick that the mayor's office has paperwork for him, a code phrase warning him that someone will attack the site that night.

A group of thugs attack Haven in the night and attempt to burn it down, but Nightwing fights them off and is able to unmask them in the process. Meanwhile, Heartless breaks into Blockbuster's office and offers to help him deal with Dick.

Supporting Characters: Alfred Pennyworth (Also as a statue) (Flashback and main story)

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #93

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Heartless offers to buy control of Bludhaven from Blockbuster, but the hulking crimelord refuses and attacks him. Heartless blocks the blow and considers killing Blockbuster, but decides against it as nobody would be sad to see him die. Instead he declares his intention to steal Bludhaven, as that is the only thing that would cause Blockbuster true pain. He turns his back to Blockbuster and begins monologuing, and so doesn't see it coming when Blockbuster attacks him from behind with a desk and throws him out of his top-storey office window.

As Nightwing, Dick tries to clean up the vandalism at Haven but is attacked by the police. He escapes pursuit but realises that Bludhaven is not safe for Nightwing and so goes to Gotham to stay with Barbara. She tells him that she has identified the men who attacked Haven in the night and he accidentally tells Barbara that he loves her. He is saved from the subsequent awkwardness by a call from Melinda, who tells him he needs to get to Haven immediately.

Commissioner Maclean has filled Haven with cops to harass the kids in the hopes of driving them away. He also calls a press conference, where he claims the kids vandalised their own community centre, but thanks to Barbara's analysis of the surveillance video Dick is able to reveal that the vandals were in fact serving Bludhaven police officers.

An injured Heartless returns to his base. His assistant Gerald examines him and tells him he is close to heart failure, and so takes a heart from his collection to replace it.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #94

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
The Bludhaven cops who attacked Haven are arrested and interrogated by the FBI. In exchange for lighter sentences they admit that Commissioner Maclean ordered them to do it. Melinda "warns" Commissioner Maclean that the Feds are coming for him and he attempts to flee with records of Blockbuster's criminal enterprises. He runs into an ambush by Nightwing who takes the files and leaves Maclean to be arrested. The next morning, the Attorney General holds a press conference where she announces that Melinda has chosen Maggie Sawyer from the DOJ's shortlist of candidates to be the new commissioner of Bludhaven PD.

After seeing the press conference, Blockbuster calls Melinda, angry that she appointed a new commissioner without consulting him. She argues that she didn't have time and, of the DOJ's preapproved candidates, she seemed like the least effective, having spent her career in a city protected by Superman. He tells Melinda he wants to meet with her immediately, and he is in her home with her mother. Melinda and Audre rush to Melinda's apartment, fearing he has harmed Meili, but when they get there they just find him having tea with her.

Blockbuster tells Melinda to come with him alone, and before she leaves Melinda whispers a message to Meili in her native language. He takes Melinda to the docks and tells her that Dick Grayson has a mole in his organisation. She is afraid he knows it is her, but he actually believes it was Electrocutioner, who he has been torturing in a warehouse on the docks. Melinda asks to be left alone with Electrocutioner and after Blockbuster leaves she cuts him loose and calls Dick to come and save them, but Electrocutioner blasts her. Blockbuster comes back in and Electrocutioner tells him that Melinda is the rat.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #95

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing and Audre track Melinda to the docks and rescue her, running Blockbuster over with a car in the process. Meanwhile at the police station, Maclean tries to cut a deal for immunity in exchange for testifying against Blockbuster with what he thinks are detectives loyal to Maggie Sawyer, but they are in fact on the take from Blockbuster and murder him. Five minutes later Sawyer finds him dead in the interrogation room but a building full of cops claim not to have seen anything.

Melinda calls Maggie to a secret meeting in a parking garage and tells her that she's been secretly working to bring Blockbuster down from the inside, and she knows of four major operations going down that very night which they can bust and cripple Blockbuster's empire. She reveals that she's working with Nightwing, who has brought a plethora of superhero allies to assist them, including Maggie's ex-fiance Batwoman. Nightwing also gives Sawyer a list of all the police officers who have taken bribes from Blockbuster.

The Bat-Family and the Titans foil all of the night's planned operations, so Blockbuster retaliates by attacking Haven. Oracle alerts Nightwing and he and Batwoman rush over to find it in flames. Nightwing follows a cry for help into the library and finds Blockbuster holding two unhoused children hostage. Blockbuster forces Nightwing to let Desmond beat him or he will kill the children. Blockbuster's blow knocks Nightwing's mask off his face, revealing that he is Dick Grayson.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #96

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing and Blockbuster battle in the burning library while Batgirl and Blockbuster's henchmen both rush to their position. When they arrive they find Haven's residents and people for the surrounding neighbourhoods working to put out the fires. Barbara shows Blockbuster's henchmen proof that he owns and profits from a hellish private prison where they have all served time. They abandon Blockbuster and go to spread the word among Bludhaven's criminals.

In the library, Blockbuster says that now he knows Nightwing's secret identity he will kill everyone Dick loves. Dick attacks him in a rage and kicks him through a third storey window to the ground outside. The people of Haven stand up to him and tell him to leave. Blockbuster tries to get away, but Brutale and Electrocutioner steal his limo and leave him to the mob. Barbara goes into the library to check on Dick, and he tells her that Blockbuster knows his secret identity and they need to break up for her safety. She laughs at him and refuses, reminding him that they are both constantly in danger no matter what, and tells him that they don't have to sacrifice their happiness to be superheroes just because Batman does. Nightwing gets over himself and realises she is right and they kiss, but Dick points out they will still need to deal with Blockbuster.

However, Blockbuster flees into an alley and runs into Heartless, who tells him that he has lost Bludhaven just as Heartless predicted. Heartless pulls Blockbuster's heart out of his chest, killing him, and says that Bludhaven belongs to him how.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #97

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Blockbuster is dead, and the police have all his records, including lists of the high-profile criminals that he and Boss Maroni had killed to eliminate the competition. Corrupt cops in the BPD leak the information to Bludhaven's underworld, leaving the surviving Maroni with a target on his back. He agrees to testify in exchange for protection and, as he is not safe in Bludhaven, Renee Montoya comes to personally transport him to Gotham.

However, the transport is run off the road by vengeful criminals, and Maroni is almost killed by a corrupt GCPD officer. Nightwing and Batgirl snatch Maroni from the scene and take him to one of Batman's bunkers in Gotham Woods. The next morning they see a taxi outside, and when they go out to investigate the driver is revealed to be a doppleganger of Dick in his "Ric Grayson" guise, who tells them to get in the car.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #98

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing confronts "Ric Grayson", who reveals himself to be a fifth dimensional imp named Nite-Mite. Like other imps before him, Mite-Mite claims to be Nightwing's biggest fan and is overjoyed to meet his idol; plus, even though his preferred ship is Nightwing/Starfire, he's happy that Dick has found love with Batgirl. He declares that their relationship needs "progression" and teleports all their friends to the woods for a wedding. They tell him they're not ready to get married and he begrudgingly sends the assembled heroes back to where they came from and teleports him and Nightwing to Bludhaven.

Nite-Mite tells Nightwing that Blockbuster had a secret daughter named Olivia whose soul he sold to Neron in exchange for greater intelligence, and now that Blockbuster is dead, Neron's demons have come to collect. He can't get directly involved because it could spark a war between Hell and the Fifth Dimension, so he empowers Nightwing's escrima sticks to banish the demons back to Hell so he can save the child. Nite-Mite also brings in Haley to help Dick, outfitting her with a costume as "Bitewing" and giving her the ability to speak.

Nightwing and Haley break into Blockbuster's skyscraper and make their way to Olivia's room, where they find her guards dead and five demons surrounding her. They defeat four of the demons but the last one grabs Olivia and holds her hostage. Olivia reveals that she has super-strength like her father and punches the demon through the wall.

Nightwing takes Olivia to Raven, as the powerful sorceress will be able to hide her from Neron. Olivia thanks Dick and Haley for saving her, and Dick tells her she should also thank Nite-Mite, as without him they would never have known she was in danger. She hugs Nite-Mite and thanks him too, despite him saying that he's not a hero. After Raven and Olivia teleport away, Nightwing asks Nite-Mite what his real name is, saying he shouldn't build his entire identity around someone else. Nite-Mite tells Dick that his real name is Dyxl, and suggests that he could become Bludhaven's "new Blockbuster", but use his money and power for good.

Supporting Characters: Nite-Mite/Dyxl (Fifth Dimension) (Real identity revealed) (First full appearance) (Impersonates Ric Grayson and Nightwing )

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #99

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Using the information from Sal Maroni's testimony and Blockbuster's records, Commissioner Maggie Sawyer leads a massive crackdown on corrupt police officers, politicians and officials, leaving Bludhaven's criminal underworld leaderless. Tony Zucco, recently released from prison, comes to Bludhaven hoping to take advantage of the power vacuum and rule the city with the help of his "daughter", Mayor Melinda Zucco. Tony tells Melinda that Maroni didn't trust digital money and stored his wealth in gemstones, and he knows where Maroni's most valuable jewel is.

The next day, Melinda meets with Dick and tells him that Zucco is back. As Nightwing, Dick trails Zucco and his new henchmen, the criminal acrobats Double Dare, from his hotel to what appears to be a shack on the beach in Bludhaven's Old Fishing District. Double Dare knock out the guard at the door and go inside, revealing a staircase leading underground. At the bottom is a vast cavern containing an old sailing galleon and a whale skeleton. Zucco tells the Marceau sisters that this is The Hold, a secret bank serving Bludhaven's elite criminals.

At gunpoint Zucco forces the "Quartermaster", the sole elderly teller dressed like an old-fashioned sailor, to open Maroni's safety deposit box containing the Eye of Kahndaq, a massive blue diamond. The Quartermaster warns him that the Hold will hunt him down for what he has done and Zucco shoots him through the eye to prevent him telling his employers who he is, but the Quartermaster somehow survives. Zucco attempts to finish him off but Nightwing appears and knocks his gun out of his hand. Zucco flees as Double Dare attempt to stop Nightwing, but he easily evades them and chases Zucco to the surface.

Nightwing tackles Zucco just before he reaches his car and is filled with rage at the sight of the man who killed his parents. He is sorely tempted to beat Zucco senseless, but they are suddenly surrounded by mercenaries working for the Hold who demand he hand Zucco over. As much as he would like to, Nightwing realises he needs to defend Zucco from being murdered by the Hold and squares off with the mercenaries; but suddenly the Quartermaster, now sporting an eyepatch, runs in and orders the mercenaries to stand down. He retrieves the Eye and tells Nightwing he is free to go and take Zucco with him, even promising to pass evidence of Zucco's crimes to the proper authorities to ensure he will face legal consequences. When Dick asks the Quartermaster why he is helping him, the Quartermaster reveals that he is also a customer of the Hold, as somebody apparently set up a safe for him without his knowledge.

The next day, Melinda goes to visit Zucco in prison. He assumes she is there to help him, but she has no plans to help him and that she knows John Grayson was her real father. He claims Meili lied to her but she tells him that the GCPD will be reopening the investigation into John and Mary's deaths, and that Meili has agreed to testify against him. She also reveals that she has legally changed her name to Grayson-Lin and that she will make sure the name "Zucco" is forgotten.

Meanwhile, Heartless takes advantage of the power vacuum created by Blockbuster's death and Maroni's arrest, and seizes control of Bludhaven's criminal underworld.

Supporting Characters: Mayor Melinda Grayson-Lin (First appearance as Melinda Grayson-Lin)

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #100

info.Pencilers: Bruno Redondo Scott McDaniel Rick Leonardi Eddy Barrows Javi Fernandez Mikel Janín
info.Inkers: Karl Story Eber Ferreira Caio Filipe Joe Prado Rick Leonardi
info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Heartless and his henchmen blast their way into Bludhaven Private Prison and free and arm all the inmates. He tells them to run riot and kill anybody who tries to stop them. He also releases Elephantman to destroy as much of the city as possible, and personally recruits KGBeast to kill Nightwing. Across the city, Nightwing hears the explosion and races over while Oracle hacks into nearby security cameras. She warns him that Heartless is acting openly now and he tells her to activate "Operation Power Shift".

Nightwing leaps down into a crowd of escaped prisoners, but rather than fight them he tells them that Heartless is a serial killer who takes parents away from children. As the prison was designed to imprison as many people as possible for profit, most of the inmates did not belong in prison and were serving sentences for minor offenses, were awaiting trial and couldn't make bail, or had been locked up because they could not afford the exorbitant "fines" that the corrupt BPD imposed on them. They turn on Heartless and help Nightwing clear the rubble from the roads so fire and medical crews can reach the prison.

The Titans arrive on scene to help. Nightwing sends Raven, Starfire and Flash to stop the actual dangerous criminals among the escapees; and Cyborg, Donna Troy and Beast Boy to capture Elephant Man. Meanwhile, in the chaos of the riot Heartless finds Tony Zucco and tells him that the entire point of the jailbreak was so they could meet. He tells Zucco that he has admired him for years, that Zucco changed his life when he killed the Flying Graysons, and that he hopes they can work together. Nightwing arrives on the scene but KGBeast tackles him before he can get to Heartless and Zucco. Dick dislocates his shoulder but he is able to fend off KGBeast and his goons long enough to the Titans to arrive and quickly defeat them. Heartless and Zucco get away, leaving behind Heartless' mask which has the words "Dick Grayson Has More To Lose" written on the inside.

Superman and Wonder Woman arrive to help, but Dick tells them the situation is already taken care of. They ask to speak with him and take him to the ruins of the Hall of Justice; where they tell him that the Justice League are rethinking how they can best help the world, and while they're doing that the world will still need to be protected. They ask him to become the overall leader of the superheroes, as his work during the Dark Crisis and the prison break have proven he is the right man for the job.

A few weeks later, he meets with Batman at Alfred's grave and asks for his advice, as he's not sure if he can lead the heroes and do what needs to be done in Bludhaven, but Batman tells him they wouldn't ask him if they didn't think he could handle it. Nightwing realises they've never visited the grave together, and Batman admits that it's harder for them to talk now that Alfred is gone, because he was always able to say the things Bruce couldn't. They take off their masks and Bruce claims that without Robin, Batman would have become a dark and brutal vigilante, but Dick assures him he is a good man and that wouldn't have happened. Bruce tells Dick he is proud of him, but also reveals that he he believes he wasn't the father Dick deserved and apologises for failing him. Dick hugs him and says that he never failed him, and he will need his guidance more than ever now. They hug again, and Dick tells Bruce he loves him.

The next day Dick, Barbara and Melinda visit the abandoned prison. Melinda tells them that the prison's owners are asking for help from the city to rebuild, but Dick asks her to sell it to the Alfred Pennyworth Foundation instead. She agrees, and also tells him that she is pushing through bail reform and forgiving the outstanding fines to prevent innocent people being sent to prison.

A month later, as Nightwing, Dick holds a press conference and unveils the new Titans Tower, built on the site of the prison.

Supporting Characters: Haley the Dog (Flashback and main story)
The Flash (Wally West) (Flashback and main story)

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #101

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen

issues.synopsis:
Neron's demons return to Hell and report that Nightwing stopped them from capturing Olivia Desmond. Neron realises that Nightwing had magical help and quickly deduces that Raven is sheltering Olivia. He enlists a shapeshifter known as the "Grinning Man", currently impersonating the King of Vlatava, to find her.

On Earth Nightwing visits the magically shielded house where Olivia is staying with Raven and Beast Boy. He tells them that a body has been detected under the rubble of Titans Academy, even though all students and staff were accounted for. He and Raven head to the former site of the Academy in New York and meet up with Starfire. Starfire dives down under the rubble and retrieves the corpse of the King of Vlatava.

Nightwing autopsies the body along with an investigator from the Vlatavan embassy. He tells the investigator that the body appears to have been placed under the rubble after the building collapsed, likely within the last twenty-four hours, and has been dead for weeks even though "the King" was seen in public only two days ago. The "investigator" is revealed to be the Grinning Man, who knocks Nightwing unconscious and shapeshifts into him. Disguised as Nightwing, the Grinning Man meets up with Raven and Starfire, and follows them through a portal back to Olivia's house.

Other Characters: King of Vlatava (Single appearance) (Unnamed) (Appears only as a corpse)

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #102

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing wakes up in a morgue freezer and cuts his way out. He calls Oracle and asks what happened to Starfire and Raven. knowing that his friends would not have willingly left him behind. She tells him that they are returning to Olivia's shelter and he warns her that something has gone wrong. She sends Cyborg to Boom Tube him to Olivia's location.

At the safehouse the Grinning Man, disguised as Nightwing, wakes Olivia up and tells her they need to leave. He leads her outside but the real Nightwing confronts him. The Grinning Man claims Dick is the impostor and attacks him, but Dick is able to prove who he is by telling Olivia his dog's name is Bitweing. She punches the Grinning Man away, however he is unharmed and grabs her, then attempts to fly away. Raven, Starfire and Cyborg are waiting for him in the air, and he attempts to escape by hurling Olivia away so they will chase after her, but instead Donna Troy catches Olivia and Starfire and Cyborg blast him out of the sky. He lands in some nearby woods where Wally West punches him out.

The Titans interrogate the Grinning Man with the Lasso of Persuasion and he tells them that he was sent by Neron. Raven tells them that Neron doesn't actually care about Olivia, but since he has already failed to harvest her soul once he needs to capture her quickly or he will look weak and his subordinates will try to overthrow him. Nightwing wonders how a contract Blockbuster signed can be used to claim Olvia's soul and Beast Boy sarcastically days they should go to Hell and steal the contract, which Raven suggests they actually do. Donna and Starfire say they will take Olivia to Themyscira while the others go to hell and steal Blockbuster's contract with Neron.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #103

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Raven and the male Titans travel to Hell to find Neron's contract with Blockbuster for Olivia's soul; while Starfire, Donna Troy and Batgirl take Olivia to Themyscira. Meanwhile, Blaze leads an army to challenge Neron, as the other lords of Hell see him as weak for his failure to claim Olivia's soul. Neron effortlessly defeats her, but realises others will follow and decides to travel to Earth personally to capture Olivia. Nightwing and the others find Blaze unconscious on the battlefield and revive her. She agrees to lead them to Neron's fortress, as if they beat him he will be weakened further. They infiltrate the tower and retrieve the contract. Nightwing hoped that he could prove the contract is invalid if Olivia's mother did not sign it, and possibly reunite them; but he discovers that Olvia's mother was Jezebel Jet, who is dead. He has another idea to save Olivia and says they need to return to Earth so he can speak with Melinda.

Neron heads to the Grinning Man's cell on Iron Heights and learns where Olivia is. A full-scale assault of demons on Themsycira would draw the wrath of the Olympians, so he must still act through mortal agents. The next day on Themyscira, the heroines are training Olivia to fight. Wonder Woman arrives and offers to spar with her, but to the other's shock she kicks Olivia will her full strength. They are attacked telepathically and the island begins to shake. "Wonder Woman" reveals that "she" is actually the Grinning Man, accompanied by Gorilla Grodd and Doctor Polaris.

At Bludhaven Town Hall, the Titans receive a distress call from Batgirl. The others Boom Tube to Themyscira while Nightwing fills out some paperwork. As soon as they are gone, Neron appears in front of him. Nightwing tells Neron that he has been declared Olivia's legal guardian, and as he did not sign Neron's contract it is null. Neron offers to give him superpowers in exchange for Olivia's soul.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #104

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Neron gives Nightwing two hours worth of superpowers, including super-strength, speed and flight. Dick considers using his new powers to defeat Neron once and for all, but Neron reminds him that his friends are currently under attack on Themyscira and Dick flies over. He pulls Gorilla Grodd out of the fight, and without his telepathic assault the Titans and Batgirl quickly overpower the other two villains. He explains what is happening to the others and they ask him what he will do with his remaining time.

In Hell, one of Neron's demons asks him why he gave Dick powers, and Neron replies that he believes he can use the power to tempt Dick into making a deal with him. Trigon comes to Neron's tower and confronts him for his failure, telling him that his inability to take Olivia's soul is making all the demon lords appear weak. He tells Neron to deal with the situation, implying that the other rulers of Hell will band together and destroy him if he does not. Neron decides the time for subtlety is over and orders a full-scale assault on Themyscira.

Back on Earth, Dick uses his powers to help Wally destroy an illegal dam in Thailand which is preventing villages downstream from receiving desperately needed water. He then decides to head to Metropolis and meet with Superman before his powers wear off. Superman takes him into space to look down at the world together. He tells Dick that protecting the world means more than just fighting villains, it also requires standing against a system which doesn't care about the future; he warns Dick that, now he is in charge of protecting the world he will upset powerful people by doing what is right. Oracle calls Dick to tell him that an army of demons is attacking Themyscira and he dives down to help.

The others tell Dick to get Olivia to safety and he flies away with her. He carries her into some mountains, where Neron is waiting for them. Nightwing's two hours of superpowers run out and they crash to Earth at Neron's feet. Neron tells Nightwing he will make the power permanent if he just gives him Olivia, tempting him with all the good he could do with them; Olivia even offers to sacrifice herself, saying that she understands the world needs him. Dick refuses and activates the residual magic in his escrima sticks; he strikes Neron, who reverts to his true form as a green, bloblike monster with tentacles and retreats back to Hell. The Titans return Olivia to Themyscira, where Donna tells her that the Amazons would be happy to take her in and train her to be a hero. Olivia eagerly accepts and thanks the Titans for saving her.

An hour later, Raven secretly travels to Hell and tells Neron she will not allow him to threaten Olivia again. She blasts the weakened demon lord, knocking him unconscious, and hands him over to Blaze. Blaze agrees to cancel Olivia's debt in exchange for Neron's throne, but tells Raven that she can sense a part of her is missing .

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #105

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Jessica Chen Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
Nightwing and Batgirl wake up at noon to a call from Melinda, who tells them that Double Dare have stolen a dangerous bioweapon and hijacked a city train. They swoop out and board the train, which is empty except for Aliki Marceau, one of the Double Dare sisters. She attempts to flee but Batgirl is able to restrain her with a thrown pair of cuffs. They ask her where the weapon is and she tells them that there is no weapon, it's a vaccine.

Aliki explains that Double Dare were hired by the nation of Vlatava to steal a vaccine for a mosquito-borne virus ravaging the country, as the manufacturer, Shel Pharmaceuticals, is asking for more than the country can afford. They robbed a truck carrying the vaccine, but were stopped by mercenaries working for Shel. Aliki injected herself with the vaccine and got away, but Margot was captured. Vlatava's scientists can synthesise the vaccine from her blood and so Shel are demanding that Aliki hand herself over in return for Margot's life, but if she does an entire nation will suffer. Aliki was attempting to flee the city on the train, after letting all the passengers and driver off, and reach her Vlatavan contacts.

Nightwing and Batgirl realise that Shel do not know that Double Dare are identical twins and therefore don't know what Aliki looks like besides the fact that she has red hair. They decide to have Batgirl, dressed in Aliki's costume, surrender to Shel so they can rescue Margot without giving up the vaccine. However, just after Barbara changes into the costume, the train is hit by a missile and derails, crashing to the street below. The mercenaries who fired the missile capture Batgirl, and shoot at Nightwing and Aliki, who flee to the rooftops. The mercenaries chase after them, and so Nightwing escapes by swinging into and crashing through the windows of a nearby office building, then taking the elevator down to the parking lot. They steal a motorcycle and follow Batgirl's tracer to a nearby parking garage.

They reach the garage and Aliki asks Nightwing why he is helping them after what they had done to him while working with Tony Zucco, and he simply replies that they needed help. He tells Aliki to stay outside and goes in to save Barbara and Margot, but he finds that Barbara has already broken free and is fighting off the mercenaries. They fight the mercenaries together until a voice over an intercom asks Nightwing to come to the boardroom. The mercenaries stand down and Nightwing goes to meet the speaker, whispering to Barbara to get Margot out.

Nightwing walks into the boardroom and meets the CEO of Shel Pharmaceuticals Shelton Lyle, who he recognises as a bully he tangled with when he was a kid in Gotham. He confronts Shelton for extorting Vlatava for the vaccine, but Shelton points out that charging extortionate prices is not illegal; and when Nightwing tells Shelton that his men blew up a train, he claims that the mercenaries are independent contractors who have already been fired, and he is not responsible for their actions. Nightwing refuses to hand the vaccine back over and leaves.

Supporting Characters: Melinda Grayson-Lin (On a TV or computer screen) (Cameo)

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #106

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey

issues.synopsis:
Two years ago, a mysterious man approaches Ric Grayson, claiming to have known him in Haly's Circus. He hands Ric an envelope and says he should have given it to him long ago. Later at the Prodigal Bar, Bea Bennet asks him if he will open it but he says it is for Dick Grayson, not him. He asks Bea if she knows anywhere it would be safe and she calls the Quartermaster of the Hold to the bar. The Quartermaster takes the envelope but Ric admits he will probably forget about it and asks the Quartermaster to list the account holder as "Nightwing". In the present day, Dick decides it's finally time to find out what is stored for him in Locker 538 on the Hold.

That evening Heartless attempts to break into the Hold and the Quartermaster comes out to confront him. The Quartermaster runs Heartless through with a sword, but he is unharmed and easily overpowers the old man. Heartless asks the Quartermaster if anyone will miss him and the Quartermaster tells him that his daughter will hunt Heartless down. Heartless simply replies "perfect" and rips out his heart. Tony Zucco, who was hiding nearby, leads Heartless down into the Hold and tells him of the riches stored there, but when they reach the bottom of the staircase, they find that the old ship and all its treasure is gone.

An hour later, Nightwing is on the scene with Commissioner Sawyer, who also tells him that the ship is gone. Oracle calls him and tells him that she ran facial recognition on the paramedics who are loading the Quartermaster's body into an ambulance and they are not in Bludhaven's medical system. Nightwing tells Sawyer that he will tell her what he knows once he gets some answers. He chases the ambulance through the streets of Bludhaven and they attempt to run him off the road. He is able to jump onto it and get inside, where he quickly knocks out the two "paramedics". The ambulance stops at the harbour and Nightwing steps out to face a large number of sailors pointing guns at him. They are ordered to stand down by "Captain Blüd", who turns out to be Bea Bennett.

Featured Characters: Nightwing (Dick Grayson/"Ric Grayson") (Flashback and main story)
Supporting Characters: Captain Blüd (Bea Bennett) (Flashback and main story) (First appearance as Captain Blüd )
Other Characters: The Hold/"The Crew of the Crossed Keys" (First appearance as The Crew of the Crossed Keys)

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #107
issues.story: "The Crew of the Crossed, Part Two"

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey

issues.synopsis:
Dick Grayson finds himself face-to-face with his ex-girlfriend Bea Bennett, who turns out to be the leader of the Hold. She tells her men to lock Nightwing up on the ship, and before they take him he sees her unzip the Quartermaster's body bag and cry over him. Dick realises that the Quartermaster was Bea's father.

Four burly sailors taken him to a prison cell below decks and attempt to beat him up, blaming him for the Quartermaster's death as Zucco lead Heartless to the Hold and the Quartermaster gave Zucco to Nightwing rather than having the Hold deal with him. Bea comes down to find them fighting and breaks it up. She takes Nightwing up to the deck and reveals that she knows he's Dick Grayson. She tells him that she is adopted and there are members of the Hold who believe that her brother, the Quartermaster's biological son Dirk Blüd, should be the captain. This would be disastrous as Dirk is a ruthless criminal who would turn the Crew of the Crossed Keys into something evil, when she has worked hard to make it a force for good. Bea tells Dick that if he helps her capture Dirk and hand him over to the authorities, she will give him his parcel.

Bea sends Dick downstairs to change out of costume and he changes into the clothes he finds in a chest: a pair of knee-high boots, tight pants and an open shirt. Meanwhile Oracle tells him that she has looked into Dirk Blüd and Bea is telling the truth about his rap sheet. He goes up on deck and Bea tells him there were normal clothes in a cupboard he missed, but that he needs to stay in that outfit now. A crewmember falls overboard and Dick is about to jump in and save him, but finds himself mysteriously frozen with fear. Bea dives in and saves the sailor instead.

When Bea gets back on the ship Dick tells her that the man was pushed and she has a traitor on the ship. Bea agrees and tells him she knows where Dirk is but she can't allow the location to get out and makes Nightwing throw his mask overboard so they can't be tracked.

Featured Characters: Nightwing (Dick Grayson/"Ric Grayson") (Flashback and main story)
Supporting Characters: The Hold/"The Crew of the Crossed Keys"
Captain Blüd (Bea Bennett) (Flashback and main story)
The Quartermaster/Captain Blüd (Appears only as a corpse) (First appearance as Captain Blüd)

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #108
issues.story: "The Crew of the Crossed, Part 3 of 4"

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey

issues.synopsis:
Travis, a member of the ship's crew, tries to assassinate Bea in her sleep; but finds that she is not in her room. Nightwing captures him and they question him, and he admits to working for Bea's brother Dirk. They leave Bea's second-in-command Lucas to interrogate Travis and Bea asks Dick why he froze on the deck earlier; and he admits that he doesn't know. Bea reveals that she has been using her influence behind the scenes to make his plans in Bludhaven possible and confronts him for dumping her when he got his memories back. Dick replies that he was trying to protect her and when she points out he is dating Batgirl without any issue he replies that she's a superhero and can look out for herself. Bea yells that she's a pirate queen but Dick points out that she never told him that. She admits that he's right, and after an awkward moment she leaves, telling him to get some sleep.

The next morning they arrive at the Crew of the Crossed Keys' hidden island, which to Dick's surprise is a modern city with skyscrapers and corporate coffee chains. As they walk through the street's to the Crow's Nest, Bea's home, Dick notices people staring at them and senses hostile energy. When they reach the Crow's Nest, Dick notices the armed guards take up an aggressive posture and realises it's a trap. Lucas opens the front door before Dick can stop him and Dirk Blüd, standing on the other side, shoots him in the chest with a shotgun. Dick releases a smoke capsule and he and Bea fight Dirk and his men. Dirk seemingly flees into the house and Bea chases after him, despite Dick yelling at her to wait.

Bea chases Dirk onto an upper level balcony and he runs her through with his sword as soon as she steps through the door. He asks her where the Hold and its treasure are but she refuses to tell him. He tells her he will just torture its location out of her crew and kicks her off the balcony and into the water below.

Supporting Characters: The Hold/"The Crew of the Crossed Keys"

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #109

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey

issues.synopsis:
Dick feels the fear surging again, but overcomes it to dive into the water below. He saves Bea and carries her ashore where they take shelter in a shack. He uses the field surgery skills that Alfred taught him to dew up her wound, fortunately Dirk missed all her vital organs and blood vessels. When Bea wakes up, he tells her that Dirk has declared himself Captain, imprisoned her crew and taken her ship. Bea says that he will be going after the Hold and she needs to beat him there. She releases Dick from his debt and tells him she will give him the contents of his box when she regains the Hold, but he insists on coming with her.

Bea flies them in a seaplane to where the Hold is hidden. Along the way she tells him the story of Hendrik Blüd, the first Captain of the Crew of the Crossed Keys, who slew a kraken that was menacing the waters around Bludhaven and is remembered in the name of the town and the huge statue in the park. She also tells him how she first met her adopted father Ruben Blüd when she stole a billionaire's superyacht which the Crew then boarded. She says that she understands why some people would prefer Dirk as Captain to her, since he is Ruben's son; but Dick tells her she is Ruben's real daughter, Dirk just happens to be related to him. When Bea takes them down, she notices Dick once again suffering a minor panic attack.

They land in the water next to the Hold's ship and the new Quartermaster, who was told Bea was dead, immediately acknowledges her as her Captain. When Dirk arrives, Dick swings down to fight him and his men, while Bea sneaks aboard the ship to free and arm her crew. They burst up on deck and demand that Dirk surrender. His men immediately drop their weapons, but Dirk won't until Bea puts her sword to his throat. She punches him out and has the Crew hand him over to the Norwegian authorities, as that is the country where he is facing the most jail time.

The Quartermaster open Dick's box and gives him the contents, which turn out to be a disc. He plays it and it is revealed to be the missing security footage from the night his parents died, proving that Tony Zucco sabotaged their trapeze. He says he needs to get back to Bludhaven and bring Zucco to justice.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #110

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Ben Abernathy

issues.synopsis:
On the first day of the Beast World event, a big game hunter turned serial murderer known as Apex Ava is imprisoned in Arkham Tower for her crimes. She is terminally ill with Sakutia and expected to die within days. A spore comes into her cell and she breaks off a spoke from her wheelchair and stabs it through the eye. She bites a chunk off the spore and eats it, her eyes glowing green. When an orderly comes in she murders him and escapes.

Three days later, Nightwing calls Jon Kent and tells him that Damian Wayne is missing. They meet up in Gotham and Jon scans for Damian's heartbeat but can't hear it, meaning he is either dead or has changed so that his heartbeat is no longer recognisable. They go to the Iceberg Lounge looking for information, and the Cobblepot siblings tell them about "The Pit", a literally underground arena where Beast-People are forced to fight.

Dick goes to the Pit in disguise while Jon hangs back to avoid being possessed. Damian, transformed into a cat, is set against a bear and is initially viciously beaten. However, just as Superman and Nightwing are about to intervene Apex Ava, who is now green and possesses the power to control the spores, orders him to fight. Damian viciously attacks and overpowers the bear, and is just about to kill it when Jon and Dick both swoop in to stop him. They carry Damian up to the surface and destroy the spore when it leaps out to possess Superman.

Apex Ava and the Pit's customers attempt to evacuate, but Nightwing and Robin collapse the tunnel in and beat them up while Superman carries the arena to the surface. Ava gets away by transforming into a bird, revealing that she has shapeshifting powers like Beast Boy, but the heroes turn the rest of the people in the Pit over to the authorities, and deliver the Beast-People to Gotham Zoo to be held until they can be treated.

Featured Characters: Robin/"Mister Mittens" (Damian Wayne) (Transformed) (First appearance as Mister Mittens)

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 111

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey

issues.synopsis:
In Gotham City, a wealthy man is murdered in front of his son. Batman responds within minutes but the killer is already long gone. As the MO of the killing matches Heartless, Batman calls Nightwing to assist. They go to GCPD headquarters so Nightwing can talk to the boy, whose name is Iko Wahid. Iko is excited to meet Nightwing and they play video games together. Dick tells Iko that he also lost his parents when he was a boy, and that it never stops hurting but he will find people who love him just as much as his parents did. He asks Iko what the man looked like, and Iko says that he wore a long coat and a mask like Heartless, but that he was silent when he did the murder. Iko's uncle Loc comes to pick him up and they leave.

Nightwing discusses what Iko told him with Batman, and tells him that every other child he spoke to about Heartless said that he forced their parents to tell him about the child who would be left behind before he killed them. He says something doesn't feel right and they should examine the body again. Batman launches his grappling hook, but after a moment's awkward pause Nightwing admits that he has been suffering from a mysterious fear of heights for weeks and can't jump anymore. Batman asks him why he didn't tell him and Nightwing points out that Batman is always in the middle of something and there was never time.

They go back to the morgue to examine the body and discover that the wound doesn't match Heartless' kills: the edges are jagged and pieces of the heart were left behind. Nightwing suggests that the killer tried to make it look like Heartless did it to throw the police off the trail. They decide to go and reinterview Iko first thing in the morning. However, Uncle Loc only takes Iko home briefly before dragging him out again, yelling that he has worked too long and hard for a superhero to ruin everything now.

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey

issues.synopsis: Batman and Nightwing go to Uncle Loc's house to speak to Iko, but finds that they are both gone. They hack into his computer and discover that Loc and Iko left on a flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Also, they find that Loc booked the tickets two weeks ago and deduce that Loc murdered Iko's father to gain control of Iko's inheritance: one of the biggest telecommunications companies in Vietnam. They hurry to Bludhaven and take the T-Jet to Ho Chi Minh City, beating the plane. They fight the corporate security, arrest Loc and rescue Iko.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 113

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey

issues.synopsis:
At 5AM on Nightwing's birthday, he and the two Robins foil an illegal arms shipment into Gotham Docks. They interrogate the captain of the ship and he tells them that he doesn't know who the weapons are for, but they are bound for a warehouse in Bludhaven. He also reveals that they have to go through Gotham because illegal shipments can't get into Bludhaven.

That evening, Dick takes his new speedboat out and approaches Bea Bennet's fishing boat which is anchored offshore. He jumps out before the boat is spotted and swims to the boat, slipping on board. He asks Bea if they have been blocking illegal shipments into Bludhaven and she says they have, but when he asks her if she knows who they are going to she leads him into the ship's hold. She shows him a body they fished out of the water who has an anatomical diagram of a heart branded on his chest. Nightwing immediately realises that Heartless is responsible.

Nightwing heads to the warehouse where the guns were bound and finds it empty, with Heartless' new symbol painted on one of the walls. He notices cameras pointed at him and tells Heartless that he is ready if Heartless is preparing for war.

Dick then goes to Bludhaven City Hall in civilian attire, where he meets back up with Damian and Tim. He tells them that the guns Heartless was trying to bring in were enough to equip an army, a major escalation from Heartless' usual MO as a serial killer. Barbara arrives and they go inside, where Melinda presents Dick and Barbara with the keys to the city in recognition for the good work the Alfred Pennyworth Foundation has done. Heartless, who has swapped out his black trenchcoat for a white suit, watches the ceremony on TV along with Gerald and Tony Zucco. He says that the city loves Dick Grayson and it is time for him to fall.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #114

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Katie Kubert

issues.synopsis:
Dick Grayson has a dream of when he was seven, and he snuck out of his family's trailer at night to climb the trapeze for the first time. He slipped halfway up the ladder and fell to the ground. He wakes up in the mountains with Haley, on the trail of something that will help him overcome his mysterious fear of heights.

Two weeks prior, Heartless calls a meeting with Maroni and Blockbuster's former lieutenants, where he tells them that they all work for him now. One of them refuses, but Heartless reveals that he has kidnapped all their children, including the man's daughter Abigail. Heartless rips out the man's heart and tells the gangsters that if they refuse to follow him, he will murder them in front of their children. However, if they agree to follow his plans, they will be richly rewarded. The others all agree, and Heartless brands his new sigil on their bare chests.

Dick, now completely unable to perform his trademark acrobatics, head to Gotham for a fundraiser for the Alfred Pennyworth Foundation. Among the members of Gotham's high society at the party is Shelton Lyle, who tells Dick he admires the good work he is doing and pledges a generous donation, but Dick privately thinks to himself that he will never take Lyle's money.

Bruce Wayne announces Dick at the fundraiser, and says that he is proud of him. However, a reporter interrupts and asks Dick how he can justify taking money from criminals, revealing that unbeknownst to Dick Blockbuster left the Foundation millions of dollars of stolen money in his will. Before Dick can respond, the fire alarms in the venue go off and Bruce tells everyone to evacuate. Shelton tells Gerald that they are about to carve out a heart.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #115

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Rob Levin

issues.synopsis:
Barbara and Damian lead the attendees at the fundraiser to the fire exits while Dick and Bruce hang back to help any stragglers. When the ballroom has been largely evacuated, Shelton Lyle runs up and tells Dick he can't find Gerald. Dick goes with Shelton to look for him while Bruce leads everyone else out. Tony Zucco, who is monitoring and controlling everything in the building from a hidden control room, deactivates the security cameras and injects a cocktail of aerosolised drugs into the fake smoke.

Dick finds Gerald seemingly collapsed on the floor, but when he reaches him, Gerald is revealed to be wearing a gas mask. Shelton, also wearing a gas mask, comes up and tells Dick the drugs he is inhaling will make him appear to have passed out from smoke inhalation and prevent him remembering anything. Dick tries to punch Shelton, but simply hurts his hand on Shelton's cyborg jaw. Shelton knocks Dick out and then he and Gerald carry Dick out, claiming that Dick pulled Gerald from some wreckage and then collapsed.

Two paramedics load Dick and Gerald into an ambulance and drive away, claiming they are taking him to Gotham General. In fact, they are working for Heartless, and pull into a nearby alley where they meet up with Shelton and Zucco. Shelton tells one of the "paramedics" to take Dick's cellphone, but when the man searches Dick he finds Nightwing's mask. Gerald immediately murders the two fake paramedics and tells Heartless that Dick's secret identity is a huge opportunity for them, but nobody else can know.

Dick wakes up groggy on a rooftop in Bludhaven. He sees a man lying face down nearby and goes over to check on him, but when he turns the man over he sees it is the reporter who questioned him at the fundraiser, and that the man has had his heart ripped out like Heartless' victims. He spot's Heartless' gun nearby and picks it up, and then suddenly a SWAT team burst onto the roof and order "Heartless" to surrender. Dick, who is revealed to be wearing Heartless' costume, attempts to flee but is unable to jump off the edge of the roof. The police shoot him in the shoulder and dogpile on him. One of them pulls off his mask, and announces that Heartless is Dick Grayson.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #116

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Rob Levin

issues.synopsis:
Dick Grayson is arrested and taken to Bludhaven Hospital under armed guard to recover from the injuries the police inflicted on him. Maggie Sawyer tries to tamp down the media's speculation, but as one of their own was killed they are out for blood. Between them the press put together the real events and false clues left by Heartless and come to the conclusion that Dick Grayson is Heartless and has been using his money and charitable foundation to control and terrorise the people of Bludhaven, and has both the police and mayor's office in his pocket. Dick wakes up in the hospital and easily escapes.

Meanwhile, Barbara is telling the entire superhero community not to break Dick out of jail and to stand down while they figure out what to do. As soon as she ends the call, Dick walks into her apartment and she runs up and hugs him in relief. Barbara tells Dick that he should reveal that he is Nightwing to clear his name, this will obviously compromise the rest of the Bat-Family but she tells him that they all discussed it and agreed to give up their secret identities to help him. Dick refuses and says he needs to unmask the real Heartless, due to the drugs he inhaled previously he does not remember that Shelton Lyle is Heartless. He says that he can't stop Heartless as long as he is experiencing his fear of heights. Barbara tells him that Batman found traces of a compound similar to Scarecrow's Fear Toxin in his blood which would induce a fear of heights. However, the concentration is so low that it shouldn't be affecting him anymore which means his physiological response to the drug has induced a psychological phobia which didn't go away when the toxin wore off.

Dick says he needs to go and see the man who helped him overcome his fears as a child: Boston Brand. After Dick's accident which trying to climb the trapeze, he became afraid of heights and asked his parents to retire so he would not risk losing them. Brand was brought in the Haly's Circus to be the new trapeze artist, but he told Dick that he could not live in fear and should fly like his parents. He offered to help Dick overcome his fears and Dick agreed.

Bea Bennet smuggles Dick and Haley out of Bludhaven on a ship to Portugal and, using the name "Robbie Malone", he travels to the foothills of the Himalayas. He climbs the mountains until he reaches Nanada Parbat and meets with Boston Brand, now Deadman. Deadman complains that Dick did not collapse in the snow just outside the city as travellers usually do and Dick asks him to help again, saying it is worse this time. Deadman tells him that is because he was only afraid of losing his parents before, and now he actually has.

In Bludhaven, Heartless broadcasts to the city. He claims to be Dick Grayson and tells them that he has turned the city into a haven for criminals and predators. He also reveals that he has people embedded in city hall, the police and walking among the general public. Heartless demands that the Titans leave the city or he will kill one person every half hour, dumping a body at the docks to prove he is not bluffing. With no other choice, the Titans depart. Heartless invites Nightwing to stay and face him alone, knowing that Dick is gone, but Batman dresses in Nightwing's costume to protect Bludhaven.

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Rob Levin

issues.synopsis:
In Nanda Parbat, Deadman tries to help Nightwing overcome his fears by possessing his body and climbing up onto a trapeze over a safety net. He leaves Dick's body and tells him to let go of the trapeze and drop to the net. Dick panics and passes out from fear, then falls. Deadman says that he thinks there is some kind of buried trauma which is holding Dick back, and suggests that if Dick is able to relax he may be able to confront his issues.

Dick goes into a scented bath and tries to slow his thoughts. He starts to wonder how he was poisoned and thinks about every villain he has encountered recently. He suddenly remembers that, during his adventure with Double Dare, he took a glass of water from Shelton Lyle. He calls Oracle and tells her that he believes Shelton is the one who drugged him. They realise that Shelton Lye must be Heartless. Barbara calls Bruce, who has been acting as Nightwing in Bludhaven, and tells him what they have discovered. Bruce was already looking into Lyle and is that very moment breaking into Shel Pharmaceuticals, and tells her he will look out for the fear toxin while he is there.

Nightwing tells Deadman that he needs to get home as soon as possible, and he needs Boston to push him past his fears. Deadman possesses Dick and climbs his body to a narrow ledge on the side of a mountain, with no way to climb up or down. Deadman leaves and tells Dick the only way off the mountain is to jump with the parachute Deadman brought with them. Dick stays on the ledge for twenty four hours, and has a nightmare about the night his parents died. Boston comes back for him and offers to climb him down, but Dick says he knows what was holding him back and jumps.

A week later, he returns to Bludhaven and reunites with Barbara and Bruce. Bruce tells Dick that he found the Fear Toxin at Shel, and that Shelton has been missing for weeks, meaning he is most likely Heartless. Dick says that he needs to talk to Melinda and goes to her home, but finds that Tony Zucco and a band of henchmen have broken in. Zucco flees while Dick is attacking his henchmen, and calls Heartless to tell him Dick Grayson is back. Dick catches up to him and tells Zucco that he now knows what was holding him back. The night his parents died, they had changed the routine so that they would jump first rather than Dick, and the guilt that they had died in his place was what had caused his trauma. He tells Zucco that he knows Tony was trying to kill him rather than his parents, which Heartless overhears.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #118

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Rob Levin

issues.synopsis:
Tony Zucco is arrested for the murder of the Graysons, but is quickly freed by a police officer whose family Heartless is holding hostage. Meanwhile, Gerald runs a diagnostic on Shelton and warns him that Blockbuster's heart is wearing out, but Shelton says he'll replace it with Nightwing's after that night.

As he knows Dick Grayson is back in town, Heartless broadcasts to the city, claiming to be Dick and announcing that he and his men will demolish Haven in one hour. While the Bat-Family search Bludhaven for the kidnapped children, Dick goes out in civilian clothes with Hayley to prove Heartless is not him. When the Heartless Army arrive at Bludhaven, a group of citizens has shown up to oppose them and the two sides briefly clash, but then Dick walks in and tells Heartless to leave. Heartless whispers that he will reveal Dick's secret identity but Dick reveals that he knows who Shelton is, and says that he has far more to lose from his secret coming out than Dick does. Suddenly he gets a call from Melinda and Babs, who tell him that the Bats have freed the kidnapped children. Dick tells the Heartless Army that their children are safe and they turn on Heartless.

Heartless flees for the docks where he has a boat waiting, and calls Gerald and tells him and Zucco to meet him there. Dick chases after him, changing into costume along the way and Hayley follows. Despite his greater speed, Heartless lets Dick keep pace with him. When they reach an overpass he jumps off it down to the docks and mocks Dick for being unable to follow him in a moment of pointless pettiness, believing the Fear Toxin is still affecting Dick. However, Dick leaps down towards the shocked Heartless and dropkicks him right in the face, knocking off his mask and breaking his teeth again.

Gerald and Zucco run in, and just as Gerald is about to shoot Dick in the head, Hayley dives in and bites him on the arm. Gerald shoots Hayley, then falls off the dock into the water and doesn't resurface. Enraged, Heartless points his gun at Zucco and says that Gerald's death is his fault as it all began with him. He says that Zucco isn't who he thought he was because he was trying to kill Dick rather than his parents. He rips out Zucco's brain, taking away Dick's chance to have Zucco face justice. Dick attacks Shelton, managing to fight evenly due to his greater skill balancing out Shelton's strength and speed. Shelton picks up a truck to hit Dick with, but then collapses as Blockbuster's heart gives out. Dick asks how he can save Shelton but Shelton says he can't, even briefly trying to kill Dick when he gets close.

Dick says that Shelton's life was meaningless, but Shelton predicts he will be remembered forever because of the things he has done. Dick tells Shelton that he will make sure nobody ever learns he was Heartless, and he will simply be one more anonymous killer; swearing that he will make sure his victims are the ones who are celebrated. Shelton dies as Dick puts his mask back on him. The next day, Dick takes Melinda to visit his parents' graves.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #119
issues.story: "On with the Show, Part 1: Curtain Up"

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Rob Levin

issues.synopsis:
A masked man presents the history of Nightwing through marionettes, including his tenure as Robin and as the leader of the Titans.

One night, four leaders of gangs meet, including Mama Bear of the Teddies, Boss Bludgeon of the Clean-Cut Crew, Dr. Proboscis of the Flyboiz, and Don Dalla of the Blockbuster Gang. Nightwing disrupts the meet but plastic explosives are set off and Nightwing is thrown into the harbor while the gang leaders die.

The next day, Dick Grayson visits his sister, Mayor Melinda Grayson-Lin, who is meeting with the C.E.O. of Spheric Solutions, Olivia Pearce. Dick and Olivia greet and Dick confronts her about Spheric Solutions making superhero-killing weapons. She explains that her company relocated to Bludhaven because of the city's Titans Tower. After Olivia leaves, Melinda explains that Olivia offered to upgrade the Bludhaven police force's weapons considering the ensuing gang war that started last night.

Nightwing confronts members of each gang and offers them protection if they don't engage in turf wars anymore.

Nightwing breaks into Spheric Solutions and encounters its security systems as Olivia watches. She appears to be working with the masked man who presented the marionette show.

issues.title: Nightwing Vol 4 #120
issues.story: "On with the Show, Part 2: Capture Their Hearts"

info.Editors: Jessica Berbey Rob Levin

issues.synopsis:
Inside Spheric Solutions, Nightwing destroys one of their attacking security drones and finds a rabbit inside controlling the drone through its fight-or-flight reflexes. He escapes Spheric Solutions with the rabbit.

The next morning, Spheric Solutions' C.E.O., Olivia Pearce, falsely claims that Nightwing was actually working with Spheric Solutions last night and that the true perpetrators were the Teddies, who were looking for tools to use against the other gangs. She introduces the Helios Project, flying police armed with enhanced weaponry.

Two Helios-enhanced officers apprehend a teddy without cause. Nightwing defends the teddy, but the officers kill the teddy in the ensuing fight. After the officers leave, two other teddies approach the angry Nightwing and reveal themselves as kids. One of them claims that the dead teddy was 14 years old and was his big brother. Nightwing pledges to destroy Spheric Solutions.
